requiredChecks.activationRule: Only promote a candidate after repeated real executions on candidate SHAs; BLOCKED/NOT_EXECUTED infrastructure states are not PASS.

candidates.reason: GitHub Actions jobs were created without assigned runner on 2026-08-27 (steps=[]).
GitHub currently registers the unquoted workflow name as PostgreSQL; issue #28 is implemented, but the check must demonstrate stable real runner executions before becoming required.
Browser QA is valuable but must not become a permanent infrastructure deadlock while runners are unavailable.
Promote only after #99 is merged and the gate has repeated real executions.

requirements: Open or reference a release/governance incident with reason and candidate SHA before bypass.
Record checks as BLOCKED, never PASS, when infrastructure did not execute them.
Use the smallest temporary rule change necessary; do not enable force-push or branch deletion.
Restore the canonical protection immediately after the exceptional integration.
Attach post-event evidence: PR, merge SHA, actor, reason, checks, timestamps and restoration verification.
Obtain independent review after the event for P0/P1 if it was impossible before the emergency merge.

rollback.principle: Rollback a bad protection configuration by restoring the last known-good policy; never solve a configuration mistake by leaving main permanently unprotected.
